Every base item that can drop in D2R-XL 2012: weapons, armor, jewellery and quivers. Click a column to sort it, or
type in a table's search box to filter.

== Tiers ==
Each weapon and armor base has six tiers. A higher tier of the same item has better base stats and more sockets but
higher requirements; the tier is shown in brackets behind the name, as in ''Giant Axe (3)''. Every base also has a
'''Sacred''' version, the strongest of all. The [[Horadric Cube]] can move an item up one tier.

== Sockets ==
Tiered and sacred items have a 25-50% chance to drop with a random number of sockets, up to the base's maximum.
Uniques, sets, crafted and honorific items always have the maximum.
